segments.output:

pim>

segments.caption: Four record types
segments.output:
add text "Buy milk and coffee"
Created PIR #1
pim>

segments.caption: Tasks have descriptions and deadlines
segments.output:
add task "Submit report" --deadline 2026-11-19 20:00
Created PIR #2
pim>

segments.caption: Events retain start and alarm timestamps
segments.output:
add event "Team meeting" --start 2026-10-12 09:00 --alarm 2026-10-12 08:30
Created PIR #3
pim>

segments.caption: Contacts preserve text and leading zeroes
segments.output:
add contact --name Alice --address "Hong Kong" --mobile "+852 01234567"
Created PIR #4
pim>

segments.caption: All records show their ID, type and fields
segments.output:
print all

#2 [task] Submit report (deadline: 2026-11-19 20:00)

pim>

segments.caption: Compound search: type, date and negation
segments.output:
search type = task && deadline < 2027-01-01 && !description contains "cancelled"
#2 [task] Submit report (deadline: 2026-11-19 20:00)
pim>

segments.caption: Quoted multiword search
segments.output:
search text contains "milk and coffee"
#1 [text] Buy milk and coffee
pim>

segments.caption: Invalid IDs produce a friendly error
segments.output:
print abc
Error: ID must be a positive integer (up to 100 digits)
pim>

segments.caption: Unknown fields cannot silently change data
segments.output:
edit 2 --unknown typo
Error: Unknown field: unknown
pim>

segments.output:

pim>
